sloka: निकृत्तचापं त्रिभिराजघान बाणैस्तदा दाशरथिः शिताग्रः ।स सायकार्तो विचचाल राजा कृच्छ्राच्च सञ्ज्ञां पुनराससाद ।। ६.५९.१०६ ।।।।
transliteration: nikṛttacāpaṁ tribhirājaghāna bāṇaistadā dāśarathiḥ śitāgraḥ ।sa sāyakārto vicacāla rājā kṛcchrācca sañjñāṁ punarāsasāda ।। 6.59.106 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana hurt by Ravana's dart, shaken up, seizing the bow feebly with great difficulty regaining consciousness tore the bow of the enemy of Indra into pieces in return.
